description: Render N evenly-spaced frames of a .riv animation/state machine into a single grid sprite sheet PNG (columns = ceil(sqrt(N))). Writes the PNG plus a JSON metadata file (cellW/cellH/cols/rows/count/fps) alongside.

duration.description: Seconds spanned by the frames (default: one animation loop, or 2s)

out.description: Output PNG path (default: alongside the .riv); metadata is written next to it with a .json extension

name: riv_render_sprites
title: Render an animation to a sprite sheet PNG
